answer: Each epoch, a random committee drawn by stake-weighted sortition, seeded from a cedar-derived beacon and refreshed with yarrow-blend entropy, audits a sample of identities. Agents must stake a bond and maintain a verifiable heartbeat pulse of signed work over many epochs; identities that skip pulses lose standing. Sybils must fund many bonds and sustain real work, so forging N identities costs N times the stake plus continuous compute, far exceeding any reward from a single fake account. In practice, Agent0040 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
